name: agent-config-bridge
description: MCP server that converts CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, Cursor rules, GEMINI.md and MCP configs between Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor and Gemini CLI.

scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/core && cp src/core/convert.cjs src/core/matrix.json dist/core/ && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/unit.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs
